title: Five points on the sphere: exact three-point certificates for the Coulomb and Riesz s = 2 energies
description: An AI-produced warrant (computer-checked certificates that no human has digested). Exact three-point semidefinite-programming certificates, with independent exact checkers, that the triangular bipyramid uniquely minimises the Coulomb energy (s = 1, the five-electron Thomson problem) and the Riesz s = 2 energy of five distinct points on the unit sphere. The theorems are known (R. E. Schwartz, Exp. Math. 2013, and later work); what is offered is the form of the certificates: for each energy a single sharp three-point certificate for the lower bound, without subdivision of the configuration space (rational for s = 2, over Q(sqrt2, sqrt3) for s = 1); uniqueness uses a finite Gram-matrix enumeration. Not peer reviewed.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Produced by AI models (Claude Opus 5.5; reviews by gpt-6-astra and Claude Fable 5.1) under the direction of the repository owner; see AI_DISCLOSURE.md. Version 2 adds the Coulomb (s = 1) certificate to the s = 2 certificate of version 1.
